items.headline: Strike notice at a German North Sea port could divert calls to Rotterdam
items.summary: A union at a German container port has announced strikes from Monday 2 November. Carriers have not yet said how they will respond.
items.impact: Some carriers may move calls to Rotterdam, which would add volume at deep-sea terminals next week. No effect expected today.

items.headline: Rail freight operator warns of slower Betuweroute services after signal fault
Port area hydrogen pipeline enters its next construction phase
items.summary: Construction of a hydrogen pipeline in the port area has moved to its next phase, according to the project company. Completion is planned for 2028.
items.impact: Long-term infrastructure news. No effect on cargo flows this week.
